concept.label: The Concept
concept.title: Where Tiki Meets Craft
body: The Lobby Tiki Bar is Oceanside’s dedicated tiki destination. Situated inside The Brick Hotel on Pier View Way, we built a space that takes the rum program seriously and the atmosphere even more so.

Every cocktail on the menu is crafted with intention — house rum blends, fresh juices, house-made syrups, and spirits chosen for the role they play. The food is island-inspired and built to complement what’s in the glass, not compete with it.
Tiki Taco Tuesdays, daily happy hour specials, private events, and a bar program that earns return visits. The Lobby is built for Oceanside to come as they are and drink well.

portfolio.label: Part of the Portfolio
portfolio.title: Grind & Prosper Hospitality
body: The Lobby is part of the Grind & Prosper Hospitality portfolio — a collection of distinct venues at The Brick Hotel on Pier View Way, Oceanside. Each is built with its own identity and program, anchored by the same commitment to craft and atmosphere.
Above The Lobby, Coco Cabana occupies the rooftop — an open-air Caribbean-influenced bar with views across Downtown Oceanside to the coast. Two venues, same building, entirely different experiences.
